name: SmartPrint printer type and readiness matrix

connectionTypes.label: Network / LAN
connectionTypes.detectedFrom: Windows TCP/IP, WSD or shared-port metadata

connectionTypes.label: IPP
connectionTypes.detectedFrom: ipp, ipps, http or https printer port URI

outputProfiles.label: Physical print
outputProfiles.description: A Windows queue that submits output to a physical or network print destination.

outputProfiles.label: PDF export
outputProfiles.description: SmartPrint generates a PDF into the paired computer's protected export folder.
outputProfiles.execution: Agent-side managed PDF export; not physical fulfilment

outputProfiles.label: Unsupported virtual
outputProfiles.description: Visible for diagnosis but not available for SmartPrint output unless the platform test override is enabled and Windows reports the queue Ready or Busy.
outputProfiles.execution: No dispatch unless explicitly promoted by platform test policy

treatWorkingVirtualQueuesAsPhysicalForTe.whenDisabled: The next successful inventory sync returns the queue to UNSUPPORTED_VIRTUAL and non-selectable.
